QuestInfo.name: A Different Time
QuestInfo.0: You were thinking of the little elf that used to follow Mercedes around, but the Athena Pierce of the Bowman Instructional School is an adult. Maybe you should ask about the young elf you knew.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce is not making any sense. Curse on the elves? Curse of the Black Mage? What's more, she says she IS the little Athena from Ossyria, and that centuries have passed since the day you remember. What is going on?
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce says it's been centuries since the Black Mage was sealed, and the heroes who sealed him have returned to travel Maple World and get stronger. It's a lot to take in, but her earnest look tells you she's speaking the truth.

0.msg: ...And that is how the heroes who succeeded in sealing the Black Mage were cursed and sealed in ice.

1.msg: I can't... I can't believe it. For me it has only been one year. But you said this happened centuries ago? Then what happened to them? Are they still trapped in ice?

2.msg: All the curses have been lifted. We don't exactly know why or how, but it must be linked to the revival of the Black Mage. The five heroes are much weaker now, so they're roaming Maple World to rebuild their skills.

3.msg: (They're alive? Finally, some good news. If I were the only one alive... I would have gone insane.)
